events.text: I am scoring the catalog to find gentle, peaceful gospel worship songs suited for quiet time and prayer.

profile.summary: Peaceful, heartfelt gospel and worship songs for quiet time, prayer, and personal devotion with God.

notices: We don't have worship in the catalog yet, so I went with the closest sound we do have: gospel.

candidates.title: Rest on Us (feat. Brandon Lake & Eniola Abioye)

events.text: I am submitting the 5-song worship playlist tailored for quiet time with God.

picks.why: CeCe Winans delivers an intimate, reverent classic with gentle acoustic warmth and deep devotion, ideal for drawing close in prayer.
Sinach's worldwide worship anthem builds a calm atmosphere of faith and quiet assurance in God's promises.
This tender prayer from Maverick City Music invites the Holy Spirit with peaceful melodies and spacious, contemplative arrangements.
Nathaniel Bassey brings a deeply spiritual, reverent worship atmosphere that lifts your eyes and focuses your meditation on God's greatness.
CeCe Winans offers pure, awe-filled adoration with soaring vocals that will quiet the noise around you and fix your attention on worship.

args.intro: We don't have a dedicated worship genre in the catalog, so I gathered our finest gospel songs suited for quiet devotion and fellowship with God. Here are five uplifting, heartfelt selections to center your spirit.
args.closing: May these songs bring peace, still your heart, and usher you into a sweet communion with God.
